svg.title: iOS 26.5 ordinary Toggle taps: native carrier observations
svg.desc: Native only, not an Android comparison. Eight actual carrier traces aligned to delivered UP. Local width, local height, and signed world center x displacement from each last observed pre-DOWN frame. No fit, interpolation, resampling or retiming. Gaps over 25 ms in either display timestamps or frame-row time are disconnected. Opacity and material alpha are not plotted.

g.text: iOS 26.5 ordinary Toggle taps · native carrier observations
Native only · no Android comparison · frame t relative to delivered UP · original window-point geometry
World center x displacement from last pre-DOWN frame (pt)
Dots = actual frames; straight connectors are visual guides. No fit, interpolation, resampling or retiming.
Disconnect if consecutive display timestamps OR frame-row t differ by >25 ms. Signed center displacement; no direction flip.
